description: Convert the legacy shell script at '/home/ga/monitoring-stack/run_commands.sh' (which contains individual 'docker run' commands) into a valid 'docker-compose.yml' file in the same directory. The stack consists of Prometheus, Grafana, and Node Exporter. You must faithfully translate all flags including networks, ports, volumes, environment variables, restart policies, and bind mounts. After creating the file, start the stack using Docker Compose. Verify that all services are running and accessible (Prometheus: 9090, Grafana: 3000, Node Exporter: 9100).
